title: What Is Euphemism? — Learn with Examples
skills: identify euphemistic language in texts and speech
analyze how euphemisms soften or reshape meaning
evaluate how euphemistic word choice influences tone, audience response, and interpretation
alignment_note: Introduces euphemism as the substitution of milder or less direct language for expressions that may be harsh, uncomfortable, or sensitive. Supports vocabulary, connotation, tone analysis, rhetoric, media literacy, and interpretation of author's word choice across high school English courses.
